claims.assertion: Mari says humanity and extraterrestrial identity form a gradual continuum, with definitions depending on criteria and perspective.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She rejects a fixed boundary between human and alien.

claims.assertion: She distinguishes starseeds, whose souls originated elsewhere before Earth incarnation, from Step Downs who physically arrive from visiting starships.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She says some starseeds recall past lives; others do not.

claims.assertion: Mari describes a spectrum of Lyrian species, from outwardly human forms to increasingly distinctive morphologies, with varied internal anatomy.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She distinguishes bodily appearance from the soul inhabiting a body.

coverage_gaps: long-term visitors integrated into Earth societies
